annotations.title: Check water test results against EPA limits

description: Lab, test-kit or utility (CCR) results in, each one compared with the EPA limit printed on OwnerSpec's EPA limits table: enforceable MCLs and action levels, PFAS MCLs, radionuclides and the non-enforceable secondary standards (iron, manganese, TDS, pH). Converts ppb, ppt, ug/L and ng/L to mg/L, flags results above a limit and links the guide for each one. Pass results as a list, or paste the report text. Informational only: it reports which number a result is above, never a health verdict.

report_text.description: Alternative to results: pasted text such as "arsenic 12 ppb, nitrate 4.1 mg/L, pH 6.2"

name.description: Parameter as printed, e.g. arsenic, nitrate, lead, PFOA, iron, pH

unit.description: mg/L, ppm, ppb, ug/L, ppt, ng/L, pCi/L or pH (default mg/L)

name: read_water_report
title: Check water test results against EPA limits
